edits.before: - Karma Focused Resolve (Tether): matchup-defining — The root tether — break it with range or line of sight. The duo’s tempo bends around it. - Keep R Breath of Life banked for their best play. - The ultimate is a fight decision, not a habit.
edits.after: - Karma's Focused Resolve (W) is 12s and roots on tether break — break it with range or line of sight before it snaps and punish while it's down. - Your Breath of Life (R) is 160/145/130s; bank it, don't habit-spend it.
